text:
Twelve women in Soweto each put R500 into their stokvel every month. Twelve women, twelve months: R72,000. On the first Sunday of December, each one goes home with R6,000 for Christmas. Thandeka's stokvel is an illustration, but the scale is real: more than 11 million South Africans belong to a stokvel, saving about R50 billion a year. And every year, some stokvels go wrong.

About the example: 12 members x R500 x 12 months = R72,000; R72,000 / 12 = R6,000 each.

Full guide: "Stokvels Explained: How to Protect Your Stokvel Money (South Africa 2026)" on the Money From Zero channel.
